title: Auto Metrics Row
description: One row per Claude Code SessionEnd (real close only, not compact/clear). v2 dropped permission_mode (Claude Code does not send it in the SessionEnd payload).

ts.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the row was written

duration_s.description: Seconds between first and last transcript entry. null if unknown or implausibly long (>24h — almost always a stale resumed transcript).

tool_distribution.description: Map of tool name → invocation count

cost_usd.description: Estimated cost. null if model is unknown and no _default fallback applied.

end_reason.description: Always 'close'. /compact and /clear are filtered at the hook.

error.description: If present, indicates the hook could not fully parse the transcript. Other fields may be zero/null.
